title: I didn’t want AI to generate the game. I wanted AI-created music to become the game.
author: Current-Quality6927

comments.author: staticFeeder
comments.body: Pop music is basically the worst of all music currently being created, and you want to condense and solidify that further through a ranking gamed system? I saw the 2 current "battles" and decided this is not at all for me.

replies.author: Current-Quality6927
replies.body:
Fair enough 😄  
If you checked both battles and decided it’s not for you, the system already did its job — just not in the direction I hoped.  
SynthArena isn’t really about proving AI music is “good”; it’s about seeing what happens when people have to judge it, rank it, and compete with it instead of just generating tracks into the void.  
And hey, the arena probably needs critics as much as it needs fans.
